correctness.rationale: On the orthocomplement of the all-ones vector, Sherman–Morrison gives the exact Kf gain. The voltage ramp produces the explicit amplitude with a square tail-imbalance penalty; the odd-parity second difference is positive, and the even-order span-two boundary is separately controlled. Explicit consecutive differences give the rational tau thresholds; strict concavity of F_w above n/2 gives strictly ordered crossing weights; F_w monotonicity below 3n/4 excludes all shorter chords. All n>=4, finite w>0 and ties are covered, backed by 67,122 exact rational/symbolic checks (n<=32) from verify.py. Finite tests are not the basis for the universal claim.
